## Checks

- [ ] I looked at it in a browser (desktop and phone width) if it changes the UI
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
- [ ] A new migration is backward compatible (the live Worker keeps working before the deploy finishes)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test
